title: VPN client cannot connect
steps: Check the user's account is not locked in the identity portal.
Ask the user to reinstall the VPN profile from the self-service catalogue.
If the gateway status is degraded, link the ticket to the open incident instead of troubleshooting further.

title: Shared mailbox missing in mail client
steps: Confirm the user is in the mailbox's access group.
Allow up to 60 minutes for group changes to sync.
Ask the user to restart the mail client.

title: Loan origination portal slow
steps: Check the service status for loan-portal.
If status is degraded, do not restart anything; raise or link a P2 incident.
Collect the user's timestamp and browser for the incident record.
